FamilyRoom.title: FamilyRoom
FamilyRoom.description: Real-time synchronized KidHero family state including stars, child profile, tasks, rewards, challenges, and discipline logs.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who created or updated the family room

stars.description: Current star balance of the child

totalStarsEarned.description: Total cumulative stars earned by the child

level.description: Current hero level of the child

currentXp.description: Current experience points of the child

payload.description: Structured KidHero application state map (profile, tasks, rewards, challenges, badges, history, discipline, watchConfig, settings)

lastSyncTimestamp.description: Client millisecond timestamp for conflict resolution

lastUpdatedAt.description: Client millisecond timestamp for last update

/families/{familyCode}.description: Stores real-time synchronized KidHero family state indexed by familyCode.
